title: My Daily Routine
content: My name is Tom. I get up at 7 o'clock every morning. I eat toast and drink coffee for breakfast. I go to work by bus. I work in an office. At 1 o'clock, I eat a sandwich for lunch. I finish work at 5 o'clock and I go home. In the evening, I watch TV and I read a book. I go to bed at 10 o'clock.

title: My Family
content: Hello! I am Emma. I have a small family. My husband is John. He is a teacher. We have two children. Their names are Leo and Mia. Leo is five years old and Mia is two years old. We also have a dog. His name is Max. Max is a big black dog. We love our family very much.

title: My House
content: I live in a small house. The house is white with a red door. Inside, there is a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom, and two bedrooms. The living room has a big sofa and a television. The kitchen is small but it has a big window. My bedroom has a bed and a desk. I like my house because it is very comfortable.
